messages:
Maria (marketing): quick heads-up 1 — we had ~12 inbound leads miss the 60s claim SLA this morning. digging in shows enrich webhook timeouts and RR slots getting recycled so leads sit unassigned.
Ashley (revops): rough. is this HubSpot-only or also SF? any pattern by geo or source?
Maria (marketing): mostly HubSpot, source=product-trial and event-signup, spike around 07:45 UTC. some vendor enrichment calls spiked to 35-40s.
Samir (ops): can you paste one raw error?
Maria (marketing): example from Enricher:
```
[2026-03-23T07:46:12Z] POST /v1/enrich -> 504
request_id=abc123 elapsed=38.7s vendor=ClearLook
payload={"email":"x@company.com"}
```
Kevin (sales-eng): sounds like the sync enrichment is blocking our RR window. proposal: switch HS flow to immediate accept + provisional owner assign, then async PATCH when enrichment returns. minimizes owner wait.
Ashley (revops): agree. quick mitigation plan: 1) lower HS wait from 30s -> 8s, 2) HS sets "provisional_owner" property at ingest using round_robin(geo_pool), 3) enricher publishes patch to /lead/:id/enrichment when done.
EnricherCI: created ticket INF-348 to add PATCH /lead/:id/enrichment and 202/Location pattern for async results.
Samir (ops): also observed RR pool parameters are tight. current: ttl=18s, eviction=LIFO. Recommend: ttl=40s + eviction=LRU + increase pool size 2->4. This prevents churn when enrich lags.
Jordan (growth): curious tradeoff: provisional owners might create duplicate outreach if enrichment later reassigns owner. how do we avoid churn?
Ashley (revops): make enrichment patch idempotent: only update owner if owner is null or marked as provisional OR if enrichment confidence>0.8. add flag `owner_locked` once SDR accepts.
Maria (marketing): can we do a small canary? maybe 3% APAC for 12h to validate metrics (claim_p50, claim_p95, owner_flip_rate, SLA_misses).
Kevin (sales-eng): +1. Also set an automated notification to #sales-eng if owner_flip_rate > 1% in canary.
Ashley (revops): I'll own the canary rollout: steps
- create canary tag (canary=accept-and-patch-v1)
- update HS workflow to set provisional_owner (workflow id: TBD)
- change enricher to emit async patch
- create dashboards (filter by canary tag)
- rollback if SLA_misses > 2% for 30m
Samir (ops): quick config diff to apply in ops repo:
```
- rr.slot_ttl: 18
- rr.eviction: LIFO
- rr.size: 2
+ rr.slot_ttl: 40
+ rr.eviction: LRU
+ rr.size: 4
+ rr.slow_path_ttl: 75
```
Maria (marketing): i'll update the inbound playbook and the webinar ops checklist with the provisional flow and the canary window. I'll also craft a short email for sales to explain provisional owner semantics.
EnricherCI: running unit tests for async patch endpoint; ETA 6h.
Kevin (sales-eng): backfill note: run backfill for unassigned leads created in last 3h to populate provisional_owner after cutover. Ashley, can you own that?
Ashley (revops): yes, will schedule backfill as a safe job after canary stable.
Jordan (growth): pls include a metric for "lead-touch-dup" (whether lead got two owner assignments within 24h) so we can quantify noise.
Samir (ops): timeline: canary start tomorrow 02:00 UTC, 3% APAC, duration 12h. rollback plan ready.
Maria (marketing): thanks team. I'll pin this thread to the playbook doc and post the canary announcement in #marketing when Ashley starts the rollout. :rocket:
